sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸未朔，暹番、沒剌由、羅斛諸國各以方物來貢，賜暹番世子虎符。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, guiwei new moon: Siam, Melaiyou, Luohu, and other states each presented local products in tribute; the Siam crown prince was granted a tiger tally.
translations.idiomatic: Third year, spring, first month, guiwei new moon: Siam, Melaiyou, Luohu, and other states each presented local products in tribute; the Siam crown prince was granted a tiger tally.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，太陰犯太白。

translations.literal: On bingxu day the moon encroached upon Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day the moon encroached upon Venus.

sentences.zh: 己丑，中書省臣言：「天變屢見，大臣宜依故事引咎避位。

translations.literal: On jichou day central secretariat officials said: "Heavenly portents have repeatedly appeared; great ministers ought according to precedent to acknowledge blame and yield their posts.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day central secretariat officials said, "Heavenly portents have repeatedly appeared; great ministers ought according to precedent to acknowledge blame and yield their posts.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「此漢人所說耳，豈可一一聽從耶？

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "This is what Han people say — how can We heed it one by one?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This is what Han people say — how can We heed it one by one?

sentences.zh: 卿但擇可者任之。

translations.literal: You need only appoint those who are suitable.
translations.idiomatic: You need only appoint those who are suitable.

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，詔遣使問民疾苦。

translations.literal: " On gengyin day an edict dispatched envoys to inquire into the people's hardships.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict dispatched envoys to inquire into the people's hardships.

sentences.zh: 除本年內郡包銀、俸鈔，免江南夏稅十分之三，增給小吏俸米。

translations.literal: The corvée purchase of wrapped silver and salary notes within the capital region for this year was abolished; three-tenths of Jiangnan summer tax was remitted; salary rice for junior clerks was increased.
translations.idiomatic: The corvée purchase of wrapped silver and salary notes within the capital region for this year was abolished; three-tenths of Jiangnan summer tax was remitted; salary rice for junior clerks was increased.

sentences.zh: 置各路惠民局，擇良醫主之。

translations.literal: Benefit-the-People Bureaus were established on each route, with skilled physicians selected to preside over them.
translations.idiomatic: Benefit-the-People Bureaus were established on each route, with skilled physicians selected to preside over them.

sentences.zh: 封藥木忽而為定遠王，賜金印。

translations.literal: Yaomuhu'er was enfeoffed as Prince of Dingyuan and granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: Yaomuhu'er was enfeoffed as Prince of Dingyuan and granted a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 命中書省：自今后妃、諸王所需，非奉旨勿給；

translations.literal: The central secretariat was ordered: from now on what consorts, imperial princesses, and princes require must not be supplied without receiving an imperial order;
translations.idiomatic: The central secretariat was ordered: from now on what consorts, imperial princesses, and princes require must not be supplied without receiving an imperial order;

sentences.zh: 各位擅置官府，紊亂選法者，戒飭之。

translations.literal: those who on their own authority established offices and confused the selection regulations were admonished.
translations.idiomatic: those who on their own authority established offices and confused the selection regulations were admonished.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，詔諸行省謹視各翼病軍。

translations.literal: On xinmao day an edict ordered each branch secretariat carefully to inspect sick soldiers in each wing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict ordered each branch secretariat carefully to inspect sick soldiers in each wing.

sentences.zh: 浙西肅政廉訪使王遇犯贓罪，托權幸規免，命御史臺鞫治之。

translations.literal: Wang Yu, surveillance commissioner of Western Zhejiang, committed corruption; relying on a favorite he sought exemption; the censorate was ordered to try him.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yu, surveillance commissioner of Western Zhejiang, committed corruption; relying on a favorite he sought exemption; the censorate was ordered to try him.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，安置高麗陪臣趙仁規於安西、崔沖紹於鞏昌，並笞而遣之，以正其附王謜擅命妄殺之罪，復以王巨為高麗王，遣工部尚書也先鐵木而、翰林待制賈汝舟賫詔往諭之。

translations.literal: On renchen day Koryo attendant ministers Zhao Rengui was resettled in Anxi and Cui Chongshao in Gongchang; both were flogged and dismissed, to rectify their crime of following King Chon in killing persons on his own authority; Wang Ju was restored as king of Koryo; Minister of Works Yesi Temür and Hanlin awaiting edict drafter Jia Ruzhou were dispatched bearing an edict to instruct him.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Koryo attendant ministers Zhao Rengui was resettled in Anxi and Cui Chongshao in Gongchang; both were flogged and dismissed, to rectify their crime of following King Chon in killing persons on his own authority; Wang Ju was restored as king of Koryo; minister of works Yesi Temür and Hanlin awaiting edict drafter Jia Ruzhou were dispatched bearing an edict to instruct him.

sentences.zh: 追收別鐵木而、脫脫合兒魯行軍印。

translations.literal: The campaign seals of Bietemuer and Tuotuhe'erlu were recalled.
translations.idiomatic: The campaign seals of Bietemuer and Tuotuhe'erlu were recalled.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「比年公帑所費，動輒巨萬，歲入之數，不支半歲，自餘皆借及鈔支。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "In recent years what the public treasury has expended often runs to tens of thousands; the annual revenue suffices for less than half a year — the remainder is all borrowed and paid from note reserves.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "In recent years what the public treasury has expended often runs to tens of thousands; the annual revenue suffices for less than half a year — the remainder is all borrowed and paid from note reserves.

sentences.zh: 臣恐理財失宜，鈔法亦壞。

translations.literal: Your subject fears that if finances are mismanaged, the note system will also be ruined.
translations.idiomatic: Your subject fears that if finances are mismanaged, the note system will also be ruined.

sentences.zh: 」帝嘉納之。

translations.literal: " The Emperor praised and accepted this.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor praised and accepted this.

sentences.zh: 仍令諭月赤察而等自今一切賜與皆勿奏。

translations.literal: They were also ordered to instruct Ochicharu and others that from now on all grants and gifts must not be memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: They were also ordered to instruct Ochicharu and others that from now on all grants and gifts must not be memorialized.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以江南軍數多闕，官吏因而作弊，詔禁飭之。

translations.literal: On guisi day, because Jiangnan army rolls had many gaps and officials took advantage to commit fraud, an edict forbade and rectified this.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day, because Jiangnan army rolls had many gaps and officials took advantage to commit fraud, an edict forbade and rectified this.

sentences.zh: 以答剌罕哈剌哈孫為中書左丞相。

translations.literal: Darqan Harqasun was made left chancellor of the central secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Darqan Harqasun was made left chancellor of the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太陰犯西垣上將。

translations.literal: On dingyou day the moon encroached upon the Western Rampart Upper General.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the moon encroached upon the Western Rampart Upper General.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，太陰犯右執法。

translations.literal: On wuxu day the moon encroached upon the Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the moon encroached upon the Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，括諸路馬，隸蒙古軍籍者免之。

translations.literal: On xinchou day horses on all routes were registered; those enrolled in Mongol army rolls were exempted.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day horses on all routes were registered; those enrolled in Mongol army rolls were exempted.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，太白經天。

translations.literal: On yisi day Venus crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Venus crossed the sky.

sentences.zh: 二月癸丑朔，車駕幸柳林。

translations.literal: Second month, guichou new moon: the imperial carriage proceeded to Willow Grove.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, guichou new moon: the imperial carriage proceeded to Willow Grove.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，完澤等奏銓定省部官，以次引見，帝皆允之，仍諭六部官曰：「汝等事多稽誤，朕昔未知其人為誰。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Wanze and others memorialized on fixing provincial and ministry offices; they were introduced in order and the Emperor approved all; he also instructed the Six Ministries officials, saying: "Your affairs are often delayed and mistaken; We formerly did not know who the persons were.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Wanze and others memorialized on fixing provincial and ministry offices; they were introduced in order and the Emperor approved all; he also instructed the Six Ministries officials, saying, "Your affairs are often delayed and mistaken; We formerly did not know who the persons were.

sentences.zh: 今既閱視，且知姓名，其洗心滌慮，各欽乃職。

translations.literal: Now that We have reviewed them and know their names, cleanse your hearts and wash away your thoughts — each respect your office.
translations.idiomatic: Now that We have reviewed them and know their names, cleanse your hearts and wash away your thoughts — each respect your office.

sentences.zh: 復蹈前失，罪不汝貸。

translations.literal: If you again repeat former faults, punishment will not spare you.
translations.idiomatic: If you again repeat former faults, punishment will not spare you.

sentences.zh: 」罷四川、福建等處行中書省，陜西行御史臺，江東、荊南、淮西三道宣慰司。

translations.literal: " The Sichuan and Fujian branch secretariats were abolished; the Shaanxi branch censorate was abolished; the Jiangdong, Jingnan, and Huaixi pacification commissions were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan and Fujian branch secretariats were abolished; the Shaanxi branch censorate was abolished; the Jiangdong, Jingnan, and Huaixi pacification commissions were abolished.

sentences.zh: 置四川、福建宣慰司都元帥府及陜西漢中道肅政廉訪司。

translations.literal: The Sichuan and Fujian pacification commission commander-in-chief headquarters and the Shaanxi Hanzhong Circuit Surveillance Commission were established.
translations.idiomatic: The Sichuan and Fujian pacification commission commander-in-chief headquarters and the Shaanxi Hanzhong Circuit Surveillance Commission were established.

sentences.zh: 廣和林、甘州城。

translations.literal: Karakorum and Ganzhou city were expanded.
translations.idiomatic: Karakorum and Ganzhou city were expanded.

sentences.zh: 詔縉山縣民戶為勢家所蔽者，悉還縣定籍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Jishan County householders shielded by powerful families all be restored to county registration.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that Jishan County householders shielded by powerful families all be restored to county registration.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔諭江浙、河南北兩省軍民。

translations.literal: On renxu day an edict instructed the civil and military populations of Jiang-Zhe and Henan North provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict instructed the civil and military populations of Jiang-Zhe and Henan North provinces.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，熒惑犯五諸侯。

translations.literal: On yisi day Mars encroached upon the Five Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Mars encroached upon the Five Dukes.

sentences.zh: 壬申，加解州鹽池神惠康王曰廣濟，資寶王曰永澤；

translations.literal: On renshen day the Salt Pond Spirit Lord Huikang of Jie Prefecture was further titled Guangji; the Precious Treasure Lord Yongze;
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day the Salt Pond Spirit Lord Huikang of Jie Prefecture was further titled Guangji; the Precious Treasure Lord Yongze;

sentences.zh: 泉州海神曰護國庇民明著天妃；

translations.literal: the Sea Spirit of Quanzhou Protect-the-Realm and Shelter-the-People Brightly Manifest Heavenly Consort;
translations.idiomatic: the Sea Spirit of Quanzhou Protect-the-Realm and Shelter-the-People Brightly Manifest Heavenly Consort;

sentences.zh: 浙西鹽官州海神曰靈感弘祐公；

translations.literal: the Sea Spirit of Yan Guan Prefecture in Western Zhejiang Spirit-perceiving Broadly Auspicious Lord;
translations.idiomatic: the Sea Spirit of Yan Guan Prefecture in Western Zhejiang Spirit-perceiving Broadly Auspicious Lord;

sentences.zh: 吳大夫伍員曰忠孝威惠顯聖王。

translations.literal: Wu Yuan, grandee of Wu, Loyalty, Filial Piety, Authority, Kindness, and Manifest Sagely King.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yuan, grandee of Wu, Loyalty, Filial Piety, Authority, Kindness, and Manifest Sagely King.

sentences.zh: 金齒國遣使來貢方物。

translations.literal: Gold Teeth sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: Gold Teeth sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On gengchen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，緬國世子信合八的奉表來謝賜衣，遣還。

translations.literal: Third month, on guisi day Burma crown prince Xinhebade presented a memorial thanking the court for granted robes and was dismissed to return.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, on guisi day Burma crown prince Xinhebade presented a memorial thanking the court for granted robes and was dismissed to return.

sentences.zh: 命妙慈弘濟大師、江浙釋教總統補陀寧一山賫詔使日本，詔曰：「有司奏陳：向者世祖皇帝嘗遣補陀禪僧如智及王積翁等兩奉璽書通好日本，咸以中途有阻而還。

translations.literal: Master Miaoci Hongji, Jiang-Zhe Buddhist chief prelate, Putuo Ning Yishan, was ordered to bear an edict as envoy to Japan; the edict said: "The relevant offices memorialized: formerly Emperor Shizu dispatched Putuo Chan monk Ruzhi and Wang Jiweng and others twice to bear seal letters and open friendly relations with Japan — all met obstruction midway and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Master Miaoci Hongji, Jiang-Zhe Buddhist chief prelate, Putuo Ning Yishan, was ordered to bear an edict as envoy to Japan; the edict said, "The relevant offices memorialized: formerly Emperor Shizu dispatched Putuo Chan monk Ruzhi and Wang Jiweng and others twice to bear seal letters and open friendly relations with Japan — all met obstruction midway and returned.

sentences.zh: 爰自朕臨御以來，綏懷諸國，薄海內外，靡有遐遺，日本之好，宜復通問。

translations.literal: Since We began to rule, We have pacified and embraced all states; within and beyond the distant seas none has been left behind — friendly relations with Japan ought to be reopened.
translations.idiomatic: Since We began to rule, We have pacified and embraced all states; within and beyond the distant seas none has been left behind — friendly relations with Japan ought to be reopened.

sentences.zh: 今如智已老，補陀僧一山道行素高，可令往諭，附商舶以行，庶可必達。

translations.literal: Now Ruzhi is old; the Putuo monk Yishan has long been of lofty conduct — he may be sent to instruct them, traveling attached to merchant vessels, so that he may certainly arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Now Ruzhi is old; the Putuo monk Yishan has long been of lofty conduct — he may be sent to instruct them, traveling attached to merchant vessels, so that he may certainly arrive.

sentences.zh: 朕特從其請，蓋欲成先帝遺意耳。

translations.literal: We specially accede to their request, intending only to fulfill the former emperor's remaining wish.
translations.idiomatic: We specially accede to their request, intending only to fulfill the former emperor's remaining wish.

sentences.zh: 至於惇好息民之事，王其審圖之。

translations.literal: As for matters of sincere friendship and giving the people rest, the king should carefully plan them.
translations.idiomatic: As for matters of sincere friendship and giving the people rest, the king should carefully plan them.

sentences.zh: 」甲午，命何榮祖等更定律令。

translations.literal: " On jiawu day He Rongzu and others were ordered to revise the statutes and ordinances.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day He Rongzu and others were ordered to revise the statutes and ordinances.

sentences.zh: 詔軍官受贓罪，重者罷職，輕者降其散官，或決罰就職停俸，期年許令自效。

translations.literal: An edict ordered: military officers guilty of corruption — the serious cases dismissed from office, lighter cases reduced in titular rank, or punished and allowed to remain in office without salary, for one year permitted to redeem themselves.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered: military officers guilty of corruption — the serious cases dismissed from office, lighter cases reduced in titular rank, or punished and allowed to remain in office without salary, for one year permitted to redeem themselves.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，熒惑犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On wuxu day Mars encroached upon Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Mars encroached upon Ghost.

sentences.zh: 升御史臺殿中司秩五品。

translations.literal: The Censorate Palace Bureau was promoted to fifth rank.
translations.idiomatic: The Censorate Palace Bureau was promoted to fifth rank.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，行御史臺劾平章教化受財三萬餘錠，教化復言平章的裏不花領財賦時盜鈔三十萬錠，及行臺中丞張閭受李元善鈔百錠，敕俱勿問。

translations.literal: On yisi day the branch censorate impeached pingzhang Jiaohua for accepting thirty thousand-odd ingots; Jiaohua further reported that when pingzhang Dirbuhua was in charge of revenues he embezzled three hundred thousand ingots, and branch censorate vice commissioner Zhang Lü accepted one hundred ingots from Li Yuanshan; an edict ordered all not to be inquired into.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the branch censorate impeached pingzhang Jiaohua for accepting 30,000-odd ingots; Jiaohua further reported that when pingzhang Dirbuhua was in charge of revenues he embezzled 300,000 ingots, and branch censorate vice commissioner Zhang Lü accepted 100 ingots from Li Yuanshan; an edict ordered all not to be inquired into.

sentences.zh: 戊申，減江南諸道行臺御史大夫一員，賜和林軍鈔十萬錠。

translations.literal: On wushen day one surveillance commissioner for Jiangnan routes was reduced; Karakorum army was granted one hundred thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day one surveillance commissioner for Jiangnan routes was reduced; Karakorum army was granted 100,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛亥朔，駙馬蠻子臺所部匱乏，以糧十三萬石賑之。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinhai new moon: because imperial son-in-law Manzitai's following was destitute, one hundred thirty thousand shi of grain was distributed in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, xinhai new moon: because imperial son-in-law Manzitai's following was destitute, 130,000 shi of grain was distributed in relief.

sentences.zh: 己未，太陰犯上將。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the moon encroached upon Upper General.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the moon encroached upon Upper General.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，填星犯輿鬼，太陰犯心。

translations.literal: On bingyin day Saturn encroached upon Ghost, and the moon encroached upon Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Saturn encroached upon Ghost, and the moon encroached upon Heart.

sentences.zh: 庚午，申嚴江浙、兩淮私鹽之禁，巡捕官驗所獲遷賞。

translations.literal: On gengwu day the ban on private salt in Jiang-Zhe and the Two Huai was strictly enforced; patrolling officers were promoted and rewarded according to seizures.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the ban on private salt in Jiang-Zhe and the Two Huai was strictly enforced; patrolling officers were promoted and rewarded according to seizures.

sentences.zh: 辛未，禁和林戍軍竄名他籍。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Karakorum garrison troops were forbidden to insert false names into other registers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Karakorum garrison troops were forbidden to insert false names into other registers.

sentences.zh: 自通州至兩淮漕河，置巡防捕盜司凡十九所。

translations.literal: From Tong Prefecture to the Two Huai grain-transport river, nineteen patrol offices for river defense and bandit capture were established in all.
translations.idiomatic: From Tong Prefecture to the Two Huai grain-transport river, 19 patrol offices for river defense and bandit capture were established in all.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以禮部尚書月古不花為中書左丞。

translations.literal: On jimao day Minister of Rites Yuegu Buhua was made left vice director of the central secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day minister of rites Yuegu Buhua was made left vice director of the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 賜和林軍鈔五十萬錠、帛四十萬匹、糧二萬石，仍命和林宣慰司市馬五千匹給之。

translations.literal: Karakorum army was granted five hundred thousand ingots of notes, four hundred thousand bolts of silks, and twenty thousand shi of grain; the Karakorum pacification commission was still ordered to purchase five thousand horses and supply them.
translations.idiomatic: Karakorum army was granted 500,000 ingots of notes, 400,000 bolts of silks, and 20,000 shi of grain; the Karakorum pacification commission was still ordered to purchase 5,000 horses and supply them.

sentences.zh: 遼東開元、咸平蒙古、女直等人乏食，以糧二萬五百石、布三千九百匹賑之。

translations.literal: Mongols, Jurchens, and others in Kaiyuan and Xianping in Liaodong lacked food; twenty thousand five hundred shi of grain and three thousand nine hundred bolts of cloth were distributed in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Mongols, Jurchens, and others in Kaiyuan and Xianping in Liaodong lacked food; 20,500 shi of grain and 3,900 bolts of cloth were distributed in relief.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，罷江南諸路釋教總統所。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on renwu day Jiangnan Buddhist chief prelate offices on all routes were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, on renwu day Jiangnan Buddhist chief prelate offices on all routes were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丙申，太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: On bingshen day the moon encroached upon Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day the moon encroached upon Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 海南速古臺、速龍探、奔奚裏諸番以虎象及桫羅木舟來貢。

translations.literal: Various tribes of Hainan including Sugutai, Sulongtan, and Benxili presented tigers, elephants, and sago-palm wood boats in tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Various tribes of Hainan including Sugutai, Sulongtan, and Benxili presented tigers, elephants, and sago-palm wood boats in tribute.

sentences.zh: 己亥，太白犯畢。

translations.literal: On jihai day Venus encroached upon Net.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Venus encroached upon Net.

sentences.zh: 庚子，免山東也速帶而牧地歲輸粟之半，禁阿而剌部毋於廣平牧馬。

translations.literal: On gengzi day half the annual grain levy from Yesudai'er's pasture lands in Shandong was remitted; the Aral tribe was forbidden to pasture horses at Guangping.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day half the annual grain levy from Yesudai'er's pasture lands in Shandong was remitted; the Aral tribe was forbidden to pasture horses at Guangping.

sentences.zh: 庚子，復征東行中書省，以福建平海省平章政事闊裏吉思為平章政事。

translations.literal: On gengzi day the Eastern Expedition branch secretariat was restored; pingzhang of Fujian Pinghai Province Kuolijisi was made pingzhang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Eastern Expedition branch secretariat was restored; pingzhang of Fujian Pinghai Province Kuolijisi was made pingzhang.

sentences.zh: 是月，鄂、嶽、漢陽、興國、常、澧、潭、衡、辰、沅、寶慶、常寧、桂陽、茶陵旱，免其酒課、夏稅；

translations.literal: That month E, Yue, Hanyang, Xingguo, Chang, Li, Tan, Heng, Chen, Yuan, Baqing, Changning, Guiyang, and Chaling suffered drought — their liquor tax and summer tax were remitted;
