sentences.zh: 御史臺臣言：「官吏犯贓及盜官錢，事覺避罪逃匿者，宜同獄成。

translations.literal: Censorate officials said, "Officials who commit corruption or steal government funds, and upon exposure flee to escape punishment, should be treated the same as if the case were concluded.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Officials who commit corruption or steal government funds, and upon exposure flee to escape punishment, should be treated the same as if the case were concluded.

sentences.zh: 雖經原免，亦加降黜，庶奸偽可革。

translations.literal: Even if pardoned, demotion and dismissal should still be added, so that deceit and fraud may be reformed.
translations.idiomatic: Even if pardoned, demotion and dismissal should still be added, so that deceit and fraud may be reformed.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以兩淮鹽法澀滯，命轉運司官兩員分司上江以整治之，仍頒印及驛券。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, because the salt laws of the Two Huai were stagnating, two transport commission officials were ordered to divide duties on the upper river to rectify them; seals and courier passes were also issued.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day, because the salt laws of the Two Huai were stagnating, two transport commission officials were ordered to divide duties on the upper river to rectify them; seals and courier passes were also issued.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，太陰犯心。

translations.literal: On xinyou day the Moon transgressed Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day the Moon transgressed Heart.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯，太陰犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: Second month, jimao day: the Moon transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, jimao day: the Moon transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 以劉深、合剌帶並為中書右丞，鄭祐為參知政事，皆佩虎符。

translations.literal: Liu Shen and Heladai were both made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat, and Zheng You was made vice director of the secretariat; all wore tiger tallies.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Shen and Heladai were both made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat, and Zheng You was made vice director of the secretariat; all wore tiger tallies.

sentences.zh: 分雲南諸路行中書省事，仍置理問官二員，郎中、員外郎、都事各一員，給圓符四、驛券二十。

translations.literal: Branch central secretariat affairs of the various routes in Yunnan were divided; two judicial inquest officials were established, one director, one vice director, and one registrar each, and four round tallies and twenty courier passes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Branch central secretariat affairs of the various routes in Yunnan were divided; two judicial inquest officials were established, one director, one vice director, and one registrar each, and four round tallies and 20 courier passes were granted.

sentences.zh: 罷福建織繡提舉司。

translations.literal: The Fujian weaving and embroidery intendancy was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Fujian weaving and embroidery intendancy was abolished.

sentences.zh: 增河間轉運司鹽為二十八萬引，罷其所屬清、滄、深三鹽司。

translations.literal: Hejian Transport Commission salt was increased to two hundred eighty thousand yin; its subordinate salt offices at Qing, Cang, and Shen were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Hejian Transport Commission salt was increased to 280,000 yin; its subordinate salt offices at Qing, Cang, and Shen were abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，立征八百媳婦萬戶府二，設萬戶四員，發四川、雲南囚徒從軍。

translations.literal: On dinghai day two ten-thousand-household offices for the campaign against Babai Xifu were established, with four commanders of ten thousand households; convicts from Sichuan and Yunnan were sent to join the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day two ten-thousand-household offices for the campaign against Babai Xifu were established, with four commanders of ten thousand households; convicts from Sichuan and Yunnan were sent to join the army.

sentences.zh: 乙未，詔廉訪司官非親喪遷葬及以病給告者，不得離職；

translations.literal: On yiwei day an edict said that surveillance commission officials, except for mourning a parent, moving a grave, or taking sick leave, must not leave their posts;
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day an edict said that surveillance commission officials, except for mourning a parent, moving a grave, or taking sick leave, must not leave their posts;

sentences.zh: 或以地遠職卑受任不赴者，臺憲勿復用。

translations.literal: those who received appointment but did not take up their posts because the place was far or the office was low-ranking should not be employed again by the censorate.
translations.idiomatic: those who received appointment but did not take up their posts because the place was far or the office was low-ranking should not be employed again by the censorate.

sentences.zh: 丙申，給脫脫等部馬萬匹。

translations.literal: On bingshen day ten thousand horses were granted to Toghto's households and others.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day 10,000 horses were granted to Toghto's households and others.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: On dingyou day the imperial carriage arrived at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the imperial carriage arrived at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 詔飭雲南行中書省減內外諸司官千五百一十四員，增江浙戍兵。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Yunnan branch central secretariat to reduce officials of internal and external offices by one thousand five hundred fourteen, and to increase garrison troops in Jiangsu and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Yunnan branch central secretariat to reduce officials of internal and external offices by 1,514, and to increase garrison troops in Jiangsu and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，賜昭應宮、興教寺地各百頃，興教仍賜鈔萬五千錠；

translations.literal: On wuxu day Zhao'ying Palace and Xingjiao Monastery were each granted one hundred qing of land; Xingjiao was additionally granted fifteen thousand ingots of paper money;
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Zhao'ying Palace and Xingjiao Monastery were each granted 100 qing of land; Xingjiao was additionally granted 15,000 ingots of paper money;

sentences.zh: 上都乾元寺地九十頃，鈔皆如興教之數；

translations.literal: Shangdu Qianyuan Monastery was granted ninety qing of land, with paper money in the same amount as Xingjiao;
translations.idiomatic: Shangdu Qianyuan Monastery was granted 90 qing of land, with paper money in the same amount as Xingjiao;

sentences.zh: 萬安寺地六百頃，鈔萬錠；

translations.literal: Wan'an Monastery six hundred qing of land and ten thousand ingots;
translations.idiomatic: Wan'an Monastery 600 qing of land and 10,000 ingots;

sentences.zh: 南寺地百二十頃，鈔如萬安之數。

translations.literal: Nan Monastery one hundred twenty qing of land, with paper money equal to Wan'an's amount.
translations.idiomatic: Nan Monastery 120 qing of land, with paper money equal to Wan'an's amount.

sentences.zh: 己亥，凡軍士殺人奸盜者，令軍民官同鞫。

translations.literal: On jihai day, for all soldiers who commit murder, rape, or robbery, military and civilian officials were ordered to try the cases together.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day, for all soldiers who commit murder, rape, or robbery, military and civilian officials were ordered to try the cases together.

sentences.zh: 永寧路總管雄挫來朝，獻馬三十餘匹，賜幣帛有差。

translations.literal: Xiong Cuo, route administrator of Yongning Route, came to court, presented more than thirty horses, and was granted silks and cloth in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong Cuo, route administrator of Yongning Route, came to court, presented more than 30 horses, and was granted silks and cloth in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，收故軍官金銀符。

translations.literal: Third month, jiachen day: former military officers' gold and silver tallies were collected.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, jiachen day: former military officers' gold and silver tallies were collected.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太陰犯御女。

translations.literal: On wushen day the Moon transgressed Maid.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Moon transgressed Maid.

sentences.zh: 己酉，罷陜西路拘榷課稅所。

translations.literal: On jiyou day the Shaanxi Route monopoly tax office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the Shaanxi Route monopoly tax office was abolished.

sentences.zh: 壬子，賜諸王也孫等鈔一萬八千五百錠。

translations.literal: On renzi day Prince Yesun and others were granted eighteen thousand five hundred ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Prince Yesun and others were granted 18,500 ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 戊午，馬來忽等海島遣使來朝，賜金素幣有差。

translations.literal: On wuwu day envoys from the islands of Malaihu and others came to court and were granted gold brocade in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day envoys from the islands of Malaihu and others came to court and were granted gold brocade in varying amounts.

sentences.zh: 給和林貧乏軍鈔二十萬錠，諸王藥木忽而所部萬五千九百餘錠。

translations.literal: Two hundred thousand ingots of paper money were granted to impoverished troops at Karakorum, and fifteen thousand nine hundred-odd ingots to Prince Yaomuhu'er's households.
translations.idiomatic: 200,000 ingots of paper money were granted to impoverished troops at Karakorum, and 15,900-odd ingots to Prince Yaomuhu'er's households.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，熒惑犯填星。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Mars transgressed Earth Star.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Mars transgressed Earth Star.

sentences.zh: 己巳，熒惑、填星相合。

translations.literal: On jisi day Mars and Earth Star came into conjunction.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Mars and Earth Star came into conjunction.

sentences.zh: 詔戒飭中外官吏。

translations.literal: An edict admonished and rectified officials within and without the court.
translations.idiomatic: An edict admonished and rectified officials within and without the court.

sentences.zh: 命遼陽行省平章沙藍將萬人駐夏山後，人備馬二匹，官給其直。

translations.literal: Shalan, branch secretariat grand councillor of Liaoyang, was ordered to command ten thousand men to garrison at Xiashanhou, each man to keep two horses, with the price paid by the government.
translations.idiomatic: Shalan, branch secretariat grand councillor of Liaoyang, was ordered to command 10,000 men to garrison at Xiashanhou, each man to keep two horses, with the price paid by the government.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，太陰犯東井。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, renshen day: the Moon transgressed Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, renshen day: the Moon transgressed Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，遣禿剌鐵木而等犒和林軍。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Tula Timur and others were sent to reward the Karakorum army.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Tula Timur and others were sent to reward the Karakorum army.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以晉王甘麻剌所部貧乏，賜鈔四十萬錠。

translations.literal: On renwu day, because Prince of Jin Gammala's households were impoverished, four hundred thousand ingots of paper money were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day, because Prince of Jin Gammala's households were impoverished, 400,000 ingots of paper money were granted.

sentences.zh: 調雲南軍征八百媳婦。

translations.literal: Yunnan troops were mobilized to campaign against Babai Xifu.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan troops were mobilized to campaign against Babai Xifu.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，禁和林釀酒，其諸王、駙馬許自釀飲，不得沽賣。

translations.literal: On guisi day wine-brewing at Karakorum was forbidden; princes and imperial sons-in-law were permitted to brew for their own consumption, but not to sell.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day wine-brewing at Karakorum was forbidden; princes and imperial sons-in-law were permitted to brew for their own consumption, but not to sell.

sentences.zh: 是月，大都、彰德、廣平、真定、順德、大名、濮州蟲食桑。

translations.literal: This month, bugs ate mulberry trees at Dadu, Zhangde, Guangping, Zhending, Shunde, Daming, and Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: This month, bugs ate mulberry trees at Dadu, Zhangde, Guangping, Zhending, Shunde, Daming, and Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月，商州隕霜殺麥。

translations.literal: Fifth month: falling frost at Shangzhou killed the wheat.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: falling frost at Shangzhou killed the wheat.

sentences.zh: 河南妖賊醜斯等伏誅。

translations.literal: The demonic rebels Chousi and others in Henan were executed.
translations.idiomatic: The demonic rebels Chousi and others in Henan were executed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，給月裏可裏軍駐夏山後者市馬鈔八萬八千七百餘錠。

translations.literal: On jiyou day eighty-eight thousand seven hundred-odd ingots of paper money were granted to Yue Li Ke Li's army garrisoning at Xiashanhou to purchase horses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day 88,700-odd ingots of paper money were granted to Yue Li Ke Li's army garrisoning at Xiashanhou to purchase horses.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，遣怯列亦帶脫脫帥師征四川。

translations.literal: On xinhai day Kielie Yidai Toghto was sent to lead troops to campaign in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Kielie Yidai Toghto was sent to lead troops to campaign in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: On guichou day the Moon transgressed Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the Moon transgressed Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，熒惑犯右執法。

translations.literal: On yimao day Mars transgressed Right Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Mars transgressed Right Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，曲靖等路宣慰使兼管軍萬戶忽林失來朝。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Hulinsi, pacification commissioner of Qujing and other routes and concurrently commander of ten thousand households, came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Hulinsi, pacification commissioner of Qujing and other routes and concurrently commander of ten thousand households, came to court.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，雲南土官宋隆濟叛。

translations.literal: On renxu day the native official Song Longji of Yunnan rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day the native official Song Longji of Yunnan rebelled.

sentences.zh: 時劉深將兵由順元入雲南，雲南右丞月忽難調民供饋，隆濟因紿其眾曰：「官軍征發汝等，將盡剪發黥面為兵，身死行陣，妻子為虜。

translations.literal: At that time Liu Shen was leading troops into Yunnan by way of Shunyuan; Yue Hunan, right vice director of Yunnan, mobilized the people to supply provisions; Longji thereupon deceived his followers, saying, "The government army has conscripted you; they will cut all your hair and tattoo your faces to make soldiers; you will die on the battlefield and your wives and children will be taken captive.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liu Shen was leading troops into Yunnan by way of Shunyuan; Yue Hunan, right vice director of Yunnan, mobilized the people to supply provisions; Longji thereupon deceived his followers, saying, "The government army has conscripted you; they will cut all your hair and tattoo your faces to make soldiers; you will die on the battlefield and your wives and children will be taken captive.

sentences.zh: 」眾惑其言，遂叛。

translations.literal: The crowd was swayed by his words and thereupon rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd was swayed by his words and thereupon rebelled.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，詔雲南行省自願征八百媳婦者二千人，人給貝子六十索。

translations.literal: On bingyin day an edict said that two thousand volunteers from Yunnan Province campaigning against Babai Xifu would each be given sixty strings of cowrie shells.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day an edict said that 2,000 volunteers from Yunnan Province campaigning against Babai Xifu would each be given 60 strings of cowrie shells.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，太白犯井。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Venus transgressed Well.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Venus transgressed Well.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，平江等十有四路大水，以糧二十萬石隨各處時直賑糶。

translations.literal: Sixth month, yihai day: fourteen routes including Pingjiang suffered great flood; two hundred thousand shi of grain was distributed for relief sale according to local prices.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, yihai day: 14 routes including Pingjiang suffered great flood; 200,000 shi of grain was distributed for relief sale according to local prices.

sentences.zh: 開中慶路昆陽州海口。

translations.literal: The estuary at Kunyang Prefecture in Zhongqing Route was opened.
translations.idiomatic: The estuary at Kunyang Prefecture in Zhongqing Route was opened.

sentences.zh: 甲申，歲星犯司怪。

translations.literal: On jiashen day Jupiter transgressed Office of Strangeness.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Jupiter transgressed Office of Strangeness.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，宋隆濟率貓、狫、紫江諸蠻四千人攻楊黃寨，殺掠甚眾。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Song Longji led four thousand barbarians of Mao, Lao, and Zijiang to attack Yang Huang Stockade, killing and plundering a great many.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Song Longji led 4,000 barbarians of Mao, Lao, and Zijiang to attack Yang Huang Stockade, killing and plundering a great many.

sentences.zh: 己丑，緬王遣使獻馴象九。

translations.literal: On jichou day the king of Burma sent envoys presenting nine tame elephants.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day the king of Burma sent envoys presenting nine tame elephants.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，宋隆濟攻貴州，知州張懷德戰死。

translations.literal: On renchen day Song Longji attacked Guizhou; prefect Zhang Huaide died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Song Longji attacked Guizhou; prefect Zhang Huaide died in battle.

sentences.zh: 梁王遣雲南行省平章幢兀兒、參政不蘭奚將兵禦之，殺賊酋撒月，斬首五百級。

translations.literal: Prince Liang sent Zhuangwu'er, branch secretariat grand councillor of Yunnan, and Vice Director Bulanxi with troops to resist them; they killed the rebel chief Sayue and took five hundred heads.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Liang sent Zhuangwu'er, branch secretariat grand councillor of Yunnan, and Vice Director Bulanxi with troops to resist them; they killed the rebel chief Sayue and took 500 heads.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太白犯輿鬼，歲星犯井。

translations.literal: On guisi day Venus transgressed Ghost, and Jupiter transgressed Well.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Venus transgressed Ghost, and Jupiter transgressed Well.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太白犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On jiawu day Venus transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Venus transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王念不烈妃劄忽而真所部鈔二十萬錠。

translations.literal: Prince Nian Bulie's consort Zhahu'er Zhen's households were granted two hundred thousand ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Nian Bulie's consort Zhahu'er Zhen's households were granted 200,000 ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 是月，汴梁、南陽、衛輝、大名、濮州旱，大都路水，順德、懷孟蝗。

translations.literal: This month, Bianliang, Nanyang, Weihui, Daming, and Puzhou suffered drought; Dadu Route suffered flood; Shunde and Huaimeng suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: This month, Bianliang, Nanyang, Weihui, Daming, and Puzhou suffered drought; Dadu Route suffered flood; Shunde and Huaimeng suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌朔，晝晦，暴風起東北，雨雹兼發，江湖泛溢，東起通、泰、崇明，西盡真州，民被災死者不可勝計，以米八萬七千餘石賑之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, wuxu day, new moon: the day was dark at noon; a violent wind rose from the northeast and rain with hail broke out together; rivers and lakes overflowed, from Tong, Tai, and Chongming in the east to Zhen Prefecture in the west; the people killed in the disaster were beyond counting; more than eighty-seven thousand shi of rice was distributed in relief.
translations.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, wuxu day, new moon: the day was dark at noon; a violent wind rose from the northeast and rain with hail broke out together; rivers and lakes overflowed, from Tong, Tai, and Chongming in the east to Zhen Prefecture in the west; the people killed in the disaster were beyond counting; more than 87,000 shi of rice was distributed in relief.

sentences.zh: 己亥，增階、沙二州戍軍。

translations.literal: On jihai day garrison troops were increased in Jie and Sha prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day garrison troops were increased in Jie and Sha prefectures.

sentences.zh: 庚子，籍安西王所侵占田、站等四百餘戶為民，賜寧遠王闊闊出所部鈔二萬三千餘錠。

translations.literal: On gengzi day more than four hundred households of fields and relay stations seized by Prince Anxi were registered as commoners; Prince Ningyuan Kuokuochu's households were granted twenty-three thousand-odd ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day more than 400 households of fields and relay stations seized by Prince Anxi were registered as commoners; Prince Ningyuan Kuokuochu's households were granted 23,000-odd ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，遼陽省大寧路水，以糧千石賑之。

translations.literal: On yisi day Daning Route in Liaoyang Province suffered flood; one thousand shi of grain was distributed in relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day Daning Route in Liaoyang Province suffered flood; 1,000 shi of grain was distributed in relief.

sentences.zh: 丙午，歲星犯井。

translations.literal: On bingwu day Jupiter transgressed Well.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Jupiter transgressed Well.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命御史大夫禿忽赤整飭臺事。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Censor-in-Chief Tugh Temür was ordered to rectify censorate affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Censor-in-Chief Tugh Temür was ordered to rectify censorate affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔軍官受贓者與民官同例，量罪大小殿黜。

translations.literal: An edict said that military officers who accepted bribes would be treated the same as civilian officials, with demotion and dismissal according to the severity of the crime.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said that military officers who accepted bribes would be treated the same as civilian officials, with demotion and dismissal according to the severity of the crime.

sentences.zh: 命監察御史審覆劄魯忽赤罪囚，檢照蒙古翰林院案牘。

translations.literal: Investigating censors were ordered to review and confirm the cases of Jalughachi prisoners and examine the files of the Mongol Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating censors were ordered to review and confirm the cases of Jalughachi prisoners and examine the files of the Mongol Hanlin Academy.

sentences.zh: 戊申，立耽羅軍民萬戶府。

translations.literal: On wushen day the Tamna military-civilian ten-thousand-household office was established.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the Tamna military-civilian ten-thousand-household office was established.

sentences.zh: 諸王也滅幹薨，以其子八八剌嗣。

translations.literal: Prince Yemegan died; his son Babala succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yemegan died; his son Babala succeeded.

sentences.zh: 己酉，詔諸司嚴禁盜賊。

translations.literal: On jiyou day an edict ordered all offices strictly to forbid bandits and thieves.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day an edict ordered all offices strictly to forbid bandits and thieves.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，太陰犯壘壁陣。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the Moon transgressed Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the Moon transgressed Encampment.

sentences.zh: 賜諸王出伯等部鈔六萬錠，又給市馬直三十八萬四千錠。

translations.literal: Prince Chubo's households and others were granted sixty thousand ingots of paper money, and thirty-eight thousand four hundred ingots were additionally granted for purchasing horses.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Chubo's households and others were granted 60,000 ingots of paper money, and 38,400 ingots were additionally granted for purchasing horses.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，詔禁畏吾兒僧、陰陽、巫覡、道人、咒師，自今有大祠禱必請而行，違者罪之。

translations.literal: On guichou day an edict forbade Uyghur monks, yin-yang masters, shamans, Daoists, and incantation masters; from now on any grand rite of prayer must be requested before proceeding, and violators would be punished.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day an edict forbade Uyghur monks, yin-yang masters, shamans, Daoists, and incantation masters; from now on any grand rite of prayer must be requested before proceeding, and violators would be punished.

sentences.zh: 浙西積雨泛溢，大傷民田，詔役民夫二千人疏導河道，俾復其故。

translations.literal: Accumulated rain in Western Zhejiang overflowed and greatly damaged the people's fields; an edict mobilized two thousand corvée laborers to dredge the river channels so they might return to their former condition.
translations.idiomatic: Accumulated rain in Western Zhejiang overflowed and greatly damaged the people's fields; an edict mobilized 2,000 corvée laborers to dredge the river channels so they might return to their former condition.

sentences.zh: 命雲南省分蒙古射士征八百媳婦。

translations.literal: Yunnan Province was ordered to dispatch Mongol archers to campaign against Babai Xifu.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan Province was ordered to dispatch Mongol archers to campaign against Babai Xifu.

sentences.zh: 庚申，辰星犯太白。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Mercury transgressed Venus.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Mercury transgressed Venus.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，合丹之孫脫歡自北境來歸，其父母妻子皆遭殺虜，賜鈔一千四百錠。

translations.literal: On guihai day Hedan's grandson Toghon returned from the northern frontier; his parents, wife, and children had all been killed or captured; he was granted one thousand four hundred ingots of paper money.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Hedan's grandson Toghon returned from the northern frontier; his parents, wife, and children had all been killed or captured; he was granted 1,400 ingots of paper money.

sentences.zh: 給諸王妃劄忽而真及諸王出伯軍鈔四十萬錠。

translations.literal: Four hundred thousand ingots of paper money were granted to Prince Consort Zhahu'er Zhen and Prince Chubo's army.
translations.idiomatic: 400,000 ingots of paper money were granted to Prince Consort Zhahu'er Zhen and Prince Chubo's army.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「舊制京師州縣捕盜，止從兵馬司，有司不與，遂致淹滯。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said, "Under the old regulations, arresting thieves in the capital's prefectures and counties was handled only by the army and horse office; the relevant offices were not involved, and thus delays occurred.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Under the old regulations, arresting thieves in the capital's prefectures and counties was handled only by the army and horse office; the relevant offices were not involved, and thus delays occurred.

sentences.zh: 自今輕罪乞令有司決遣，重者從宗正府聽斷，庶不留獄，且民不冤。

translations.literal: From now on we ask that minor offenses be decided and dispatched by the relevant offices, and serious ones be adjudicated by the imperial clan court, so that cases may not remain in prison and the people may not suffer injustice.
translations.idiomatic: From now on we ask that minor offenses be decided and dispatched by the relevant offices, and serious ones be adjudicated by the imperial clan court, so that cases may not remain in prison and the people may not suffer injustice.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 以暗伯、阿忽臺並知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Anbo and Ahuotai were both made privy council administrators.
translations.idiomatic: Anbo and Ahuotai were both made privy council administrators.

sentences.zh: 禁富豪之家役軍。

translations.literal: Rich and powerful households were forbidden to employ soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: Rich and powerful households were forbidden to employ soldiers.

sentences.zh: 詔封贈非中書省無輒奏請。

translations.literal: An edict directed that enfeoffments and posthumous honors must not be memorialized except through the central secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that enfeoffments and posthumous honors must not be memorialized except through the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 稱海至北境十二站大雪，馬牛多死，賜鈔一萬一千餘錠。

translations.literal: Heavy snow from Chenghai to the twelve northern frontier relay stations killed many horses and cattle; more than eleven thousand ingots of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy snow from Chenghai to the 12 northern frontier relay stations killed many horses and cattle; more than 11,000 ingots of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 命御史臺檢照宣政院並僧司案牘。

translations.literal: The censorate was ordered to inspect the records of the Xuanzheng Commission and the Monks' Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: The censorate was ordered to inspect the records of the Xuanzheng Commission and the Monks' Directorate.

sentences.zh: 升太醫院為二品，以平章政事、大都護、提點太醫事脫因納為太醫院使。

translations.literal: The Imperial Medical Academy was promoted to rank two; Grand Councillor, Chief Protector of the Capital, and Supervisor of Imperial Medical Affairs Tuoyinna was made director of the Imperial Medical Academy.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Medical Academy was promoted to rank two; grand councillor, chief protector of the capital, and supervisor of imperial medical affairs Tuoyinna was made director of the Imperial Medical Academy.

sentences.zh: 賜上都諸匠等鈔二十一萬七千四百錠。

translations.literal: Two hundred seventeen thousand four hundred ingots of notes were granted to artisans and others at Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: 217,400 ingots of notes were granted to artisans and others at Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 大都、保定、河間、濟寧、大名水，廣平、真定蝗。

translations.literal: Dadu, Baoding, Hejian, Jining, and Daming suffered flooding; Guangping and Zhending suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: Dadu, Baoding, Hejian, Jining, and Daming suffered flooding; Guangping and Zhending suffered locusts.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，給軍人羊馬價及定遠王所部鈔十四萬三千錠。

translations.literal: Eighth month, wuchen day: price payments for soldiers' sheep and horses and one hundred forty-three thousand ingots of notes for the Prince of Dingyuan's department were issued.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuchen day: price payments for soldiers' sheep and horses and 143,000 ingots of notes for the Prince of Dingyuan's department were issued.

sentences.zh: 己巳，平灤路霖雨，灤、漆、淝、汝河溢，民死者眾，免其今年田租，仍賑粟三萬石。

translations.literal: On jisi day continuous rain in Pingluan Route caused the Luan, Qi, Fei, and Ru rivers to overflow; many commoners died; this year's field rent was remitted and thirty thousand shi of grain were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day continuous rain in Pingluan Route caused the Luan, Qi, Fei, and Ru rivers to overflow; many commoners died; this year's field rent was remitted and 30,000 shi of grain were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 庚午，禿剌鐵木而等自和林犒軍還，言：「和林屯田宜令軍官廣其墾辟，量給農具，倉官宜任選人，可革侵盜之弊。

translations.literal: On gengwu day Talatiemuer and others returned from Karakorum after rewarding the troops, saying: "Karakorum garrison farming should have military officers expand reclamation, issue agricultural implements as appropriate, and granary officers should be appointed from selected men — this can eliminate the abuse of embezzlement.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Talatiemuer and others returned from Karakorum after rewarding the troops, saying, "Karakorum garrison farming should have military officers expand reclamation, issue agricultural implements as appropriate, and granary officers should be appointed from selected men — this can eliminate the abuse of embezzlement.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，遣薛超兀而等將兵征金齒諸國，時征緬師還，為金齒所遮，士多戰死。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Xue Chaowu'er and others were dispatched to lead troops against the Gold Teeth and other states; at that time the Burma expedition army was returning and was intercepted by the Gold Teeth — many soldiers died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Xue Chaowu'er and others were dispatched to lead troops against the Gold Teeth and other states; at that time the Burma expedition army was returning and was intercepted by the Gold Teeth — many soldiers died in battle.

sentences.zh: 又接連八百媳婦諸蠻，相效不輸稅賦，賊殺官吏，故皆征之。

translations.literal: Moreover the Eight Hundred Wives and various barbarians in succession followed suit in not paying taxes and levies, killing officials as bandits — therefore all were to be attacked.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Eight Hundred Wives and various barbarians in succession followed suit in not paying taxes and levies, killing officials as bandits — therefore all were to be attacked.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，詔：「遣官分道賑恤。

translations.literal: On gengchen day an edict directed: "Officials are to be dispatched by separate routes to give relief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day an edict directed, "Officials are to be dispatched by separate routes to give relief.

sentences.zh: 凡獄囚禁系累年，疑不能決者，令廉訪司具其疑狀，申呈省、臺詳讞，仍為定例。

translations.literal: All prisoners detained for years whose cases cannot be decided should have the surveillance commission report the doubtful circumstances and submit them to the secretariat and censorate for detailed adjudication, and this shall be made a standing regulation.
translations.idiomatic: All prisoners detained for years whose cases cannot be decided should have the surveillance commission report the doubtful circumstances and submit them to the secretariat and censorate for detailed adjudication, and this shall be made a standing regulation.

sentences.zh: 各路被災重者，免其差稅一年，貧乏之家，計口賑恤，尤甚者優給之。

translations.literal: In every route severely afflicted by disaster, corvée taxes are remitted for one year; impoverished households receive relief counted by mouth; those especially severe receive preferential grants.
translations.idiomatic: In every route severely afflicted by disaster, corvée taxes are remitted for one year; impoverished households receive relief counted by mouth; those especially severe receive preferential grants.

sentences.zh: 小吏犯贓者，並罷不敘。

translations.literal: Petty clerks guilty of embezzlement are all dismissed without further appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Petty clerks guilty of embezzlement are all dismissed without further appointment.

sentences.zh: 」征緬萬戶曳剌福山等進馴象六。

translations.literal: " Burma campaign wanhu Yelie Fushan and others presented six trained elephants.
translations.idiomatic: Burma campaign wanhu Yelie Fushan and others presented six trained elephants.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太陰犯軒轅御女。

translations.literal: On renchen day the Moon transgressed the Maid of Xuan Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the moon transgressed the Maid of Xuan Yuan.

sentences.zh: 乙未，填星犯太微上將。

translations.literal: On yiwei day Saturn transgressed the Upper General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Saturn transgressed the Upper General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 順德路水，免其田租。

translations.literal: Shunde Route suffered flooding; its field rent was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Shunde Route suffered flooding; its field rent was remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，放稱海守倉庫軍還，令以次更代。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guichou day: Chenghai warehouse-guard troops were released to return, to be replaced in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, guichou day: Chenghai warehouse-guard troops were released to return, to be replaced in rotation.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，江陵、常德、澧州皆旱，並免其門攤、酒醋課。

translations.literal: On bingchen day Jiangling, Changde, and Li Prefecture all suffered drought; their stall, wine, and vinegar taxes were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Jiangling, Changde, and Li Prefecture all suffered drought; their stall, wine, and vinegar taxes were remitted.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，自八月庚辰彗出井，歷紫微垣至天市垣，凡四十六日而滅。

translations.literal: On yiyou day, from gengchen day of the eighth month a comet emerged at Well, passed through the Purple Forbidden Enclosure to the Celestial Market Enclosure — in all forty-six days then it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day, from gengchen day of the eighth month a comet emerged at Well, passed through the Purple Forbidden Enclosure to the Celestial Market Enclosure — in all 46 days then it vanished.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙寅朔，以畿內歲饑，增明年海運糧為百二十萬石。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, bingyin new moon: because of famine within the metropolitan region, next year's sea-transport grain was increased to one million two hundred thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, bingyin new moon: because of famine within the metropolitan region, next year's sea-transport grain was increased to 1,200,000 shi.

sentences.zh: 己巳，緬王遣使入貢。

translations.literal: On jisi day the king of Burma sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the king of Burma sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，雲南武定路土官群則獻方物。

translations.literal: On wuyin day native official Qunze of Wuding Route in Yunnan presented local products.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day native official Qunze of Wuding Route in Yunnan presented local products.

sentences.zh: 癸未，太陰犯東井。

translations.literal: On guimao day the Moon transgressed Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the moon transgressed Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 壬午，車駕還大都。

translations.literal: On renwu day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以歲饑禁釀酒，弛山澤之禁，聽民捕獵。

translations.literal: On bingxu day, because of famine, wine-brewing was forbidden; prohibitions on mountains and lakes were relaxed, and commoners were allowed to hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day, because of famine, wine-brewing was forbidden; prohibitions on mountains and lakes were relaxed, and commoners were allowed to hunt.

sentences.zh: 湖廣行省臣言：「海南海北道宣慰司都元帥府，不與軍務，遇有盜竊，惟行文移，比回，已不及事，今乞以其長二人領軍務。

translations.literal: Huguang branch secretariat officials said: "The Hainan and Haibei circuit pacification commissioner's headquarters of military commissioners does not participate in military affairs; when theft occurs, only documents are sent — by the time replies return, the affair is already beyond remedy; we now request that two of its chiefs be placed in charge of military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Huguang branch secretariat officials said, "The Hainan and Haibei circuit pacification commissioner's headquarters of military commissioners does not participate in military affairs; when theft occurs, only documents are sent — by the time replies return, the affair is already beyond remedy; we now request that two of its chiefs be placed in charge of military affairs.

sentences.zh: 又鎮守官慢功當罰者，已有定例；

translations.literal: Moreover for garrison commanders who are negligent in merit, there is already a fixed regulation for punishment;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover for garrison commanders who are negligent in merit, there is already a fixed regulation for punishment;

sentences.zh: 獲功當賞者，乞或加散官，或授金、銀符。

translations.literal: for those who merit reward for achievement, we request that either supernumerary rank be added or gold or silver tallies be granted.
translations.idiomatic: for those who merit reward for achievement, we request that either supernumerary rank be added or gold or silver tallies be granted.

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 撥南陽府屯田地給新籍畏吾而戶，俾耕以自贍，仍給糧三月。

translations.literal: Garrison-farm fields in Nanyang Prefecture were allocated to newly registered Uighur households so they could farm for self-support; grain for three months was still issued.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison-farm fields in Nanyang Prefecture were allocated to newly registered Uighur households so they could farm for self-support; grain for three months was still issued.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔：「軍官既受命而不時赴者、病故不行者、被差事畢不即還者，準民官例，違限六月，選人代之，被代者期年始敘。

translations.literal: On dinghai day an edict directed: "Military officers who after receiving appointment do not arrive on time, who on account of illness or death do not go, or who after assigned duties are finished do not promptly return — following the regulation for civilian officials, after six months in violation a replacement is selected; the replaced officer resumes rank after one year.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict directed, "Military officers who after receiving appointment do not arrive on time, who on account of illness or death do not go, or who after assigned duties are finished do not promptly return — following the regulation for civilian officials, after six months in violation a replacement is selected; the replaced officer resumes rank after one year.

sentences.zh: 」改鄂州路為武昌路。

translations.literal: " Ezhou Route was changed to Wuchang Route.
translations.idiomatic: Ezhou Route was changed to Wuchang Route.

sentences.zh: 遣使就調雲南、四川、福建、廣東、廣西官，諭百司凡事關中書省者，毋得輒奏。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to adjust officials in Yunnan, Sichuan, Fujian, Guangdong, and Guangxi, instructing all offices that matters pertaining to the central secretariat must not be memorialized presumptuously.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to adjust officials in Yunnan, Sichuan, Fujian, Guangdong, and Guangxi, instructing all offices that matters pertaining to the central secretariat must not be memorialized presumptuously.

sentences.zh: 權豪勢要之家佃戶貸糧者，聽於來歲秋成還之。

translations.literal: Tenant households of powerful and influential families who borrowed grain were permitted to repay after the autumn harvest of the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: Tenant households of powerful and influential families who borrowed grain were permitted to repay after the autumn harvest of the coming year.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，分碉門、黎、雅軍戍蠻夷，命陜西屯田萬戶也不幹等將之。

translations.literal: On guisi day troops of Diaomen, Li, and Ya were divided to garrison barbarian regions; Shaanxi garrison-farm wanhu Yebugan and others were ordered to lead them.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day troops of Diaomen, Li, and Ya were divided to garrison barbarian regions; Shaanxi garrison-farm wanhu Yebugan and others were ordered to lead them.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，夜有流星大如杯，光燭地，自北起近東分為二星，沒於危宿。

translations.literal: On xinmao day at night a meteor as large as a cup, its light illuminating the ground, rose from the north near the east, divided into two stars, and set at the constellation Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day at night a meteor as large as a cup, its light illuminating the ground, rose from the north near the east, divided into two stars, and set at the constellation Rooftop.

sentences.zh: 十一月己亥，歲星犯東井，詔諭中書，近因禁酒，聞年老需酒之人有預市而儲之者，其無釀具者勿問。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jihai day: Jupiter transgressed Eastern Well; an edict addressed the central secretariat: recently because of the wine prohibition, it was heard that elderly persons needing wine had pre-purchased and stored it — those without brewing equipment should not be questioned.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jihai day: Jupiter transgressed Eastern Well; an edict addressed the central secretariat: recently because of the wine prohibition, it was heard that elderly persons needing wine had pre-purchased and stored it — those without brewing equipment should not be questioned.

sentences.zh: 罷湖南轉運司弘州種田提舉司，以其事入有司。

translations.literal: Hunan transport commission's Hongzhou farming promotion office was abolished and its affairs transferred to the regular offices.
translations.idiomatic: Hunan transport commission's Hongzhou farming promotion office was abolished and its affairs transferred to the regular offices.

sentences.zh: 降容、象、橫、賓路為州，平灤金丹提舉司為管勾，升昭州為平樂府，省泌縣入唐州。

translations.literal: Rong, Xiang, Heng, and Bin routes were reduced to prefectures; Pingluan gold and cinnabar promotion office was reduced to an overseer; Zhao Prefecture was promoted to Pingle Prefecture; Mi County was annexed into Tang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Rong, Xiang, Heng, and Bin routes were reduced to prefectures; Pingluan gold and cinnabar promotion office was reduced to an overseer; Zhao Prefecture was promoted to Pingle Prefecture; Mi County was annexed into Tang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁未，遣劉國傑及也先忽都魯將兵萬人，八剌及阿塔赤將兵五千人，征宋隆濟。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Liu Guojie and Yesian Hudul were dispatched to lead ten thousand troops; Bala and Ataqchi to lead five thousand troops — to campaign against Song Longji.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Liu Guojie and Yesian Hudul were dispatched to lead 10,000 troops; Bala and Ataqchi to lead 5,000 troops — to campaign against Song Longji.

sentences.zh: 減直糶米，賑京師貧民，設肆三十六所，其老幼單弱不能自存者，廩給五月。

translations.literal: Grain was sold at reduced price to relieve the poor of the capital; thirty-six shops were established; those elderly, young, solitary, or weak who could not support themselves received granary provisions for five months.
translations.idiomatic: Grain was sold at reduced price to relieve the poor of the capital; 36 shops were established; those elderly, young, solitary, or weak who could not support themselves received granary provisions for five months.

sentences.zh: 選六衛扈從漢軍習武事，仍禁萬戶以下毋令私代，犯者斷罪有差。

translations.literal: Han army bodyguard troops of the Six Guards were selected for military training; also forbidden that subordinates below wanhu be privately replaced — offenders sentenced according to gradations.
translations.idiomatic: Han army bodyguard troops of the Six Guards were selected for military training; also forbidden that subordinates below wanhu be privately replaced — offenders sentenced according to gradations.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太陰犯昴。

translations.literal: On wushen day the Moon transgressed Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 徭人藍賴率丹陽三十六洞來降，以賴等為融州懷遠縣簿、尉。

translations.literal: Yao tribesman Lan Lai led the thirty-six caves of Danyang in submission; Lan Lai and others were made registrars and marshals of Huaiyuan County in Rong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yao tribesman Lan Lai led the 36 caves of Danyang in submission; Lan Lai and others were made registrars and marshals of Huaiyuan County in Rong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 立長信寺，秩三品。

translations.literal: Changxin Temple was established at rank three.
translations.idiomatic: Changxin Temple was established at rank three.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，歲星犯司怪。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiaxu day: Jupiter transgressed Oddities.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiaxu day: Jupiter transgressed Oddities.

sentences.zh: 給安西王所部軍士食，令各還其家，候春調遣。

translations.literal: Rations were issued to soldiers under the Prince of Anxi; each was ordered to return home and await spring mobilization.
translations.idiomatic: Rations were issued to soldiers under the Prince of Anxi; each was ordered to return home and await spring mobilization.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，太陰犯南斗。

translations.literal: On xinmao day the Moon transgressed Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the moon transgressed Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 征東行省平章闊裏吉思以不能和輯高麗罷。

translations.literal: Eastern Expedition branch secretariat pingzhang Kuolijisi was dismissed for inability to harmonize with Koryo.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Expedition branch secretariat pingzhang Kuolijisi was dismissed for inability to harmonize with Koryo.

sentences.zh: 定強竊盜條格，凡盜人孳畜者，取一償九，然後杖之。

translations.literal: Regulations on robbery and theft were fixed: whoever steals another's livestock pays ninefold compensation, then receives beating.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations on robbery and theft were fixed: whoever steals another's livestock pays ninefold compensation, then receives beating.

sentences.zh: 是歲，汴梁、歸德、南陽、鄧州、唐州、陳州、和州、襄陽、汝寧、高郵、揚州、常州蝗，峽州、隨州、安陵、荊門、泰州、光州、揚州、滁州、高郵、安豐霖，汴梁之封丘、陽武、蘭陽、中牟、延津，河南澠池，蘄州之蘄春、廣濟、蘄水旱，大名、宣德、奉聖、歸德、寧海、濟寧、般陽、登州、萊州、益都、濰州、博興、東平、濟南、濱州、保定、河間、真定、大寧水。

translations.literal: That year Bianliang, Guide, Nanyang, Deng Prefecture, Tang Prefecture, Chen Prefecture, He Prefecture, Xiangyang, Runing, Gaoyou, Yangzhou, and Changzhou suffered locusts; Xizhou, Suizhou, Anling, Jingmen, Taizhou, Guang Prefecture, Yangzhou, Chuzhou, Gaoyou, and Anfeng suffered excessive rain; Fengqiu, Yangwu, Lanyang, Zhongmu, and Yanjin in Bianliang, Mianchi in Henan, Qichun, Guangji, and Qishui in Qizhou suffered drought; Daming, Xuande, Fengsheng, Guide, Ninghai, Jining, Panyang, Dengzhou, Laizhou, Yidu, Weizhou, Boxing, Dongping, Jinan, Binzhou, Baoding, Hejian, Zhending, and Daning suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: That year Bianliang, Guide, Nanyang, Deng Prefecture, Tang Prefecture, Chen Prefecture, He Prefecture, Xiangyang, Runing, Gaoyou, Yangzhou, and Changzhou suffered locusts; Xizhou, Suizhou, Anling, Jingmen, Taizhou, Guang Prefecture, Yangzhou, Chuzhou, Gaoyou, and Anfeng suffered excessive rain; Fengqiu, Yangwu, Lanyang, Zhongmu, and Yanjin in Bianliang, Mianchi in Henan, Qichun, Guangji, and Qishui in Qizhou suffered drought; Daming, Xuande, Fengsheng, Guide, Ninghai, Jining, Panyang, Dengzhou, Laizhou, Yidu, Weizhou, Boxing, Dongping, Jinan, Binzhou, Baoding, Hejian, Zhending, and Daning suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 是歲，斷大辟六十一人。

translations.literal: That year sixty-one persons were sentenced to death.
translations.idiomatic: That year 61 persons were sentenced to death.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月癸卯，詔千戶、百戶等自軍逃歸，先事而逃者罪死，敗而後逃者，杖而罷之，沒入其男女。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, guimao day, edict: qianhu, baihu, and others who desert and return from the army — those who flee beforehand are punished by death; those who flee after defeat are beaten and dismissed, their male and female dependents confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth year, spring, first month, guimao day, edict: qianhu, baihu, and others who desert and return from the army — those who flee beforehand are punished by death; those who flee after defeat are beaten and dismissed, their male and female dependents confiscated.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，中書省臣言：「廣東宣慰副使脫歡察而收捕盜賊，屢有勞績，近廉訪司劾其私置兵仗、擅殺土寇等事，遣官鞫問，實無私罪，乞加獎諭。

translations.literal: On yisi day central secretariat officials said: "Guangdong pacification vice commissioner Tuohuancha'er in capturing bandits and robbers repeatedly had meritorious achievements; recently the surveillance commission impeached him for privately setting up arms, summarily killing local bandits, and other matters; officials were dispatched to interrogate — in fact there was no private crime; we request increased reward and encouragement.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day central secretariat officials said, "Guangdong pacification vice commissioner Tuohuancha'er in capturing bandits and robbers repeatedly had meritorious achievements; recently the surveillance commission impeached him for privately setting up arms, summarily killing local bandits, and other matters; officials were dispatched to interrogate — in fact there was no private crime; we request increased reward and encouragement.

sentences.zh: 」命賜衣二襲。

translations.literal: " Two sets of garments were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Two sets of garments were granted.

sentences.zh: 晉王甘麻剌薨，命封其王印及內史府印。

translations.literal: Prince of Jin Gammala died; the princely seal and inner secretariat seal were ordered sealed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Jin Gammala died; the princely seal and inner secretariat seal were ordered sealed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，京畿二十一站闕食，命賜鈔萬二千七百餘錠。

translations.literal: On bingwu day twenty-one relay stations in the metropolitan region lacked provisions; more than twelve thousand seven hundred ingots of notes were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day 21 relay stations in the metropolitan region lacked provisions; more than 12,700 ingots of notes were granted.

sentences.zh: 陜西旱，禁民釀酒。

translations.literal: Shaanxi suffered drought; commoners were forbidden to brew wine.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi suffered drought; commoners were forbidden to brew wine.

sentences.zh: 以雲南站戶貧乏，增馬及鈔以優恤之。

translations.literal: Because Yunnan relay households were impoverished, horses and notes were increased for preferential relief.
translations.idiomatic: Because Yunnan relay households were impoverished, horses and notes were increased for preferential relief.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣以朱清、張瑄屢致人言，乞罷其職，徙其諸子官江南者於京。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials, because Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan repeatedly drew public comment, requested their dismissal from office and transfer of their sons holding office in Jiangnan to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials, because Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan repeatedly drew public comment, requested their dismissal from office and transfer of their sons holding office in Jiangnan to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丁未，命江浙平章阿裏專領其省財賦。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Zhejiang pingzhang Ali was ordered to take exclusive charge of that province's revenues.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Zhejiang pingzhang Ali was ordered to take exclusive charge of that province's revenues.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔官吏犯罪已經赦宥者，仍從核問。

translations.literal: On gengxu day an edict directed that officials guilty of crimes already amnestied are still to be investigated and questioned.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day an edict directed that officials guilty of crimes already amnestied are still to be investigated and questioned.

sentences.zh: 海道漕運船，令探馬赤軍與江南水手相參教習，以防海寇。

translations.literal: Sea-route transport grain ships were ordered to have tammaq troops and Jiangnan sailors jointly trained to guard against sea bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Sea-route transport grain ships were ordered to have tammaq troops and Jiangnan sailors jointly trained to guard against sea bandits.

sentences.zh: 江南僧石祖進告朱清、張瑄不法十事，命御史臺詰問之。

translations.literal: Jiangnan monk Shi Zujin reported ten illegal acts of Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan; the censorate was ordered to interrogate them.
translations.idiomatic: Jiangnan monk Shi Zujin reported ten illegal acts of Zhu Qing and Zhang Xuan; the censorate was ordered to interrogate them.

sentences.zh: 帝語臺臣曰：「朕聞江南富戶侵占民田，以致貧者流離轉徙，卿等嘗聞之否？

translations.literal: The Emperor said to censorate officials: "We have heard that rich households in Jiangnan encroach on commoners' fields, causing the poor to drift away and migrate — have you heard of this?
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said to censorate officials, "We have heard that rich households in Jiangnan encroach on commoners' fields, causing the poor to drift away and migrate — have you heard of this?

sentences.zh: 」臺臣言曰：「富民多乞護持璽書，依倚以欺貧民，官府不能詰治，宜悉追收為便。

translations.literal: " Censorate officials said: "Rich households frequently request protective imperial letters and rely on them to defraud poor commoners; government offices cannot investigate and punish — it would be convenient to recover them all.
translations.idiomatic: Censorate officials said, "Rich households frequently request protective imperial letters and rely on them to defraud poor commoners; government offices cannot investigate and punish — it would be convenient to recover them all.

sentences.zh: 」命即行之，毋越三日。

translations.literal: " Ordered to implement immediately, not to exceed three days.
translations.idiomatic: Ordered to implement immediately, not to exceed three days.

sentences.zh: 詔自今僧官、僧人犯罪，御史臺與內外宣政院同鞫，宣政院官徇情不公者，聽御史臺治之。

translations.literal: An edict directed that from now on when Buddhist officials and monks commit crimes, the censorate and the internal and external Xuanzheng commission jointly try them; where Xuanzheng commission officials show favoritism and injustice, the censorate is permitted to punish them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that from now on when Buddhist officials and monks commit crimes, the censorate and the internal and external Xuanzheng commission jointly try them; where Xuanzheng commission officials show favoritism and injustice, the censorate is permitted to punish them.

sentences.zh: 增諸王塔赤鐵木而歲賜銀二百五十兩、雜幣百匹。

translations.literal: Prince Tachi Temur's annual grant was increased by two hundred fifty taels of silver and one hundred bolts of miscellaneous silks.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Tachi Temur's annual grant was increased by 250 taels of silver and 100 bolts of miscellaneous silks.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，築渾河堤長八十里，仍禁豪家毋侵舊河，令屯田軍及民耕種。

translations.literal: On yimao day the Hun River dike was built eighty li long; powerful households were forbidden from encroaching on the old river channel; garrison-farm troops and commoners were ordered to plant fields.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Hun River dike was built 80 li long; powerful households were forbidden from encroaching on the old river channel; garrison-farm troops and commoners were ordered to plant fields.

sentences.zh: 增劉國傑等軍，仍令屯戍險隘，俟秋進師。

translations.literal: Liu Guojie's army was augmented; still ordered to garrison strategic passes until autumn when the army would advance.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Guojie's army was augmented; still ordered to garrison strategic passes until autumn when the army would advance.

sentences.zh: 命劄忽而帶、阿裏等整治江南影占稅民地土者。

translations.literal: Zhahu'erdai, Ali, and others were ordered to rectify those in Jiangnan who covertly occupied tax-paying commoners' land.
translations.idiomatic: Zhahu'erdai, Ali, and others were ordered to rectify those in Jiangnan who covertly occupied tax-paying commoners' land.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「御史臺、廉訪司，體察、體覆，前後不同。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "The censorate and surveillance commissions — field inspection and on-site verification — have differed before and after.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "The censorate and surveillance commissions — field inspection and on-site verification — have differed before and after.

sentences.zh: 初立臺時，止從體察，後立按察司，事無大小，一皆體覆。

translations.literal: When the censorate was first established, only field inspection was used; later when the surveillance commission was established, matters great and small were all subject to on-site verification.
translations.idiomatic: When the censorate was first established, only field inspection was used; later when the surveillance commission was established, matters great and small were all subject to on-site verification.

sentences.zh: 由是憲司之事，積不能行。

translations.literal: Consequently censorate affairs accumulated without being carried out.
translations.idiomatic: Consequently censorate affairs accumulated without being carried out.

sentences.zh: 請自今除水旱災傷體覆，余依舊例體察為宜。

translations.literal: We request that from now on, aside from flood, drought, and disaster damage using on-site verification, the remainder follow the old regulation of field inspection as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: We request that from now on, aside from flood, drought, and disaster damage using on-site verification, the remainder follow the old regulation of field inspection as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 以大都、平灤等路去年被水，其軍應赴上都駐夏者，免其調遣一年。

translations.literal: Because Dadu, Pingluan, and other routes were afflicted by water last year, troops due to go to Shangdu for summer residence were exempted from mobilization for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Because Dadu, Pingluan, and other routes were afflicted by water last year, troops due to go to Shangdu for summer residence were exempted from mobilization for one year.

sentences.zh: 詔軍官除邊遠出征，其餘遇祖父母、父母喪，依民官例，立限奔赴。

translations.literal: An edict directed that military officers, aside from distant frontier campaigns, when encountering mourning for grandparents or parents follow civilian official regulations with fixed limits for departure.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed that military officers, aside from distant frontier campaigns, when encountering mourning for grandparents or parents follow civilian official regulations with fixed limits for departure.

sentences.zh: 禁畜養鷹、犬、馬、駝等人擾民。

translations.literal: Raising hawks, dogs, horses, camels, and the like to disturb the people was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Raising hawks, dogs, horses, camels, and the like to disturb the people was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以諸王真童誣告濟南王，謫置劉國傑軍中自效。

translations.literal: On yiwei day, because Prince Zhentong falsely accused the Prince of Jinan, he was demoted and placed in Liu Guojie's army to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day, because Prince Zhentong falsely accused the Prince of Jinan, he was demoted and placed in Liu Guojie's army to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，鎮星犯太微垣上將。

translations.literal: On renxu day Saturn transgressed the Upper General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Saturn transgressed the Upper General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，太陰犯昴。

translations.literal: Second month, gengwu day: the Moon transgressed Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, gengwu day: the moon transgressed Hairy Head.

sentences.zh: 謫諸王孛羅於四川八剌軍中自效。

translations.literal: Prince Bolo was demoted to serve in the Sichuan Bala army to redeem himself.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Bolo was demoted to serve in the Sichuan Bala army to redeem himself.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，增諸王出伯軍三千人，人備馬二匹，官給其直。

translations.literal: On guiyou day Prince Chubo's army was increased by three thousand men, each supplied with two horses at government expense.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Prince Chubo's army was increased by 3,000 men, each supplied with two horses at government expense.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，遣陜西省平章也速帶而、參政汪惟勤將川陜軍，湖廣平章劉國傑將湖廣軍，征亦乞不薛，一切軍務，並聽也速帶而、劉國傑節制。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Shaanxi branch secretariat pingzhang Yesudai'er and associate administrator Wang Weiqi were dispatched to lead Sichuan and Shaanxi armies; Huguang pingzhang Liu Guojie to lead Huguang armies — to campaign against Yiqibuxie; all military affairs were placed under Yesudai'er and Liu Guojie's command.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Shaanxi branch secretariat pingzhang Yesudai'er and associate administrator Wang Weiqi were dispatched to lead Sichuan and Shaanxi armies; Huguang pingzhang Liu Guojie to lead Huguang armies — to campaign against Yiqibuxie; all military affairs were placed under Yesudai'er and Liu Guojie's command.

sentences.zh: 罷征八百媳婦右丞劉深等官，收其符印、驛券。

translations.literal: Right vice chancellor Liu Shen and others of the Eight Hundred Wives campaign were dismissed; their tallies, seals, and relay vouchers were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: Right vice chancellor Liu Shen and others of the Eight Hundred Wives campaign were dismissed; their tallies, seals, and relay vouchers were confiscated.

sentences.zh: 以京師民乏食，命省、臺委官計口驗實，以鈔十一萬七千一百餘錠賑之。

translations.literal: Because the capital's people lacked food, the secretariat and censorate were ordered to dispatch officials to count mouths and verify; more than one hundred seventeen thousand one hundred ingots of notes were issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: Because the capital's people lacked food, the secretariat and censorate were ordered to dispatch officials to count mouths and verify; more than 117,100 ingots of notes were issued for relief.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，帝有疾，釋京師重囚三十八人。

translations.literal: On guisi day the Emperor fell ill; thirty-eight serious prisoners in the capital were released.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the Emperor fell ill; 38 serious prisoners in the capital were released.

sentences.zh: 三月丁酉，以旱、溢為災，詔赦天下。

translations.literal: Third month, dingyou day: because of drought and flooding as disasters, an edict granted amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, dingyou day: because of drought and flooding as disasters, an edict granted amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 大都、平灤被災尤甚，免其差稅三年，其餘災傷之地，已經賑恤者免一年。

translations.literal: Dadu and Pingluan were especially severely afflicted — their corvée taxes remitted for three years; other disaster-afflicted places already relieved remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Dadu and Pingluan were especially severely afflicted — their corvée taxes remitted for three years; other disaster-afflicted places already relieved remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 今年內郡包銀、俸鈔，江淮已南夏稅，諸路鄉村人戶散辦門攤課程，並蠲免之。

translations.literal: This year's inner-circuit package silver, salary notes, summer tax south of the Yangtze and Huai, and villager household stall taxes in every route were all remitted.
translations.idiomatic: This year's inner-circuit package silver, salary notes, summer tax south of the Yangtze and Huai, and villager household stall taxes in every route were all remitted.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太陰犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On renyin day the Moon transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the moon transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 命僧設水陸大會七晝夜。

translations.literal: Monks were ordered to perform a great land-and-water assembly for seven days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: Monks were ordered to perform a great land-and-water assembly for seven days and nights.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，歲星犯井。

translations.literal: On guimao day Jupiter transgressed Well.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Jupiter transgressed Well.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，太陰犯鉤鈐。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the moon transgressed Hooked Clasp.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the moon transgressed Hooked Clasp.

sentences.zh: 合祭昊天上帝、皇地祇於南郊，遣中書左丞相答剌罕哈剌哈孫攝事。

translations.literal: A joint sacrifice to the Supreme Ruler of August Heaven and August Earth was held at the southern suburb; Left Chancellor of the Central Secretariat Dalaqan Halaqsun was dispatched to preside over the rites.
translations.idiomatic: A joint sacrifice to the Supreme Ruler of August Heaven and August Earth was held at the southern suburb; left chancellor of the central secretariat Dalaqan Halaqsun was dispatched to preside over the rites.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑朔，太白犯東井。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on the yichou new moon, Venus transgressed Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on the yichou new moon, Venus transgressed Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔曲赦雲南諸部蠻夷；

translations.literal: On dingmao day an edict granted a partial amnesty to the various barbarian tribes of Yunnan;
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict granted a partial amnesty to the various barbarian tribes of Yunnan;

sentences.zh: 發通州倉粟三百石賑貧民；

translations.literal: three hundred shi of grain from the Tongzhou granary were issued to relieve impoverished commoners;
translations.idiomatic: 300 shi of grain from the Tongzhou granary were issued to relieve impoverished commoners;

sentences.zh: 釋輕重囚三十八人，人給鈔五錠。

translations.literal: thirty-eight prisoners of lighter and heavier offenses were released, each granted five ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: 38 prisoners of lighter and heavier offenses were released, each granted five ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，浚永清縣南河。

translations.literal: On yihai day the southern river at Yongqing County was dredged.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day the southern river at Yongqing County was dredged.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太陰犯心。

translations.literal: On wuyin day the moon transgressed Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the moon transgressed Heart.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上都大水民饑，減價糶糧萬石賑之。

translations.literal: On gengchen day Shangdu suffered great flooding and the people were hungry; ten thousand shi of grain was sold at reduced prices for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Shangdu suffered great flooding and the people were hungry; 10,000 shi of grain was sold at reduced prices for relief.

sentences.zh: 戊子，修盧溝上流石徑山河堤。

translations.literal: On wuzi day the river embankment at Shijing Shan on the upper Lu River was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day the river embankment at Shijing Shan on the upper Lu River was repaired.

sentences.zh: 釋重囚。

translations.literal: Heavy offenders were released.
translations.idiomatic: Heavy offenders were released.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸上都。

translations.literal: The imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial carriage proceeded to the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，太白犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Venus transgressed Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Venus transgressed Ghost.

sentences.zh: 真定、大名、河間等路蝗。

translations.literal: Locusts afflicted Zhending, Daming, Hejian, and other routes.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts afflicted Zhending, Daming, Hejian, and other routes.

sentences.zh: 五月乙巳，給貧乏漢軍地，及五丁者一頃，四丁者二頃，三丁者三頃，其孤寡者存恤六年，逃散者招諭復業。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on yisi day: land was granted to impoverished Han army households — one qing to those with five adult males, two qing to those with four, three qing to those with three; the orphaned, widowed, and solitary were sustained for six years; those who had fled and scattered were summoned and urged to return to their occupations.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on yisi day, land was granted to impoverished Han army households — one qing to households with five adult males, two qing to those with four, three qing to those with three; the orphaned, widowed, and solitary were sustained for six years; those who had fled and scattered were summoned and urged to return to their occupations.

sentences.zh: 戊申，太廟寢殿災。

translations.literal: On wushen day fire destroyed the sleeping hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day fire destroyed the sleeping hall of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，謫和林潰軍征雲南，其戰傷而歸及嘗奉晉王令旨、諸王藥木忽而免者，不遣。

translations.literal: On guichou day routed troops from Karakorum ordered to campaign against Yunnan were banished; those wounded in battle and returned, and those once exempted by order of the Prince of Jin or Prince Yaomuhu'er, were not sent.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day routed troops from Karakorum ordered to campaign against Yunnan were banished; those wounded in battle and returned, and those once exempted by order of the Prince of Jin or Prince Yaomuhu'er, were not sent.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，福州路饑，賑以糧一萬四千七百石。

translations.literal: On dingsi day Fuzhou Route suffered famine; relief was granted with fourteen thousand seven hundred shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Fuzhou Route suffered famine; relief was granted with 14,700 shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 濟南路大水，揚州、淮安路蝗，歸德、徐州、邳州水。

translations.literal: Jinan Route suffered great flooding; Yangzhou and Huai'an routes suffered locusts; Guide, Xuzhou, and Pizhou suffered flooding.
translations.idiomatic: Jinan Route suffered great flooding; Yangzhou and Huai'an routes suffered locusts; Guide, Xuzhou, and Pizhou suffered flooding.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on the guihai new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on the guihai new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 太史院失於推策，詔中書議罪以聞。

translations.literal: The Bureau of Astronomy failed in calendar calculation; the central secretariat was ordered to deliberate on punishments and report.
